title: Lexical Resource and Collocations
focus: Usar combinações frequentes e paráfrases naturais
verifiableTask: Reformular oito afirmações com sentido preservado

content.text: (vocabulário) no IELTS não é usar palavras difíceis: é usar
(dizer a mesma coisa com outras palavras).
Ao final da aula você consegue:
reformular frases sem mudar o sentido usando sinônimos, mudança de classe de palavra e collocations.
reformular oito afirmações com sentido preservado.
Diga de outra forma (o professor ajuda):
A lot of people use phones.
The number of cars have increased since 2010.
a decision · progress · a mistake · an effort · a difference
action · responsibility · a break · part in · advantage of
an impact on · an effect on · access to
Cities are growing rapidly → The rapid growth of cities…
Many people think… → It is widely believed that…
Pronúncia: ouça, compare e repita (collocations como um bloco)
Governments should take action, because heavy traffic has a serious impact on health.

explanations.general: Scientists do research on climate change.
We need to take action now.

questions.questionText: Technology has a big impact ______ education.

explanations.general: Technology has a big impact on education.

questions.questionText: Best paraphrase of “Many people think that…”

explanations.general: Correct answer: It is widely believed that…

content.text: a primeira frase do ensaio deve
evita repetir a palavra da pergunta.
Cuidado: sinônimo nem sempre é igual!
Some people think that the government should spend more money on public transport.
It is often argued that authorities ought to invest more in public transportation systems.
→ make progress / take responsibility / pay attention / take action / make an effort
→ a positive effect on / a major influence on / a significant effect on
4.2 Sinônimo ou não? (diga se a troca funciona)

questions.questionText: Does “a big mistake → a large mistake” work?

options.text: No, “large mistake” is unnatural; use “big/serious mistake”

explanations.general: Correct answer: No, “large mistake” is unnatural; use “big/serious mistake”

explanations.B: Correto: strong coffee é a collocation.

questions.questionText: Prices increased dramatically. → There was a dramatic ______ in prices. (substantivo)

explanations.general: There was a dramatic increase in prices.

questions.questionText: Tourism has developed quickly. → The quick ______ of tourism… (substantivo)
People are concerned about pollution. → There is growing ______ about pollution.

explanations.general: There is growing concern about pollution.

questions.questionText: Students should take ______ of free online courses. (aproveitar)

explanations.general: Students should take advantage of free online courses.

content.text: Use pelo menos 2 técnicas em cada (sinônimo, classe de palavra, estrutura). O sentido
Many young people spend too much time on social media.
The government should build more hospitals.
Some people believe that homework is not useful.
Air pollution is a big problem in large cities.
Technology has changed the way we communicate.
It is important for children to do sports.
Most tourists visit the city in summer.
O aluno lê as paráfrases. O professor pergunta:
Is the meaning the same? Is the collocation natural?
What can individuals do to reduce pollution?
Escreva uma frase com cada collocation de
(dicionário de collocations online, ex.: Oxford Collocations).
Reescreva 5 enunciados de IELTS Task 2 (encontre exemplos oficiais) com 2 técnicas cada.
Leia a frase-modelo e as 8 paráfrases em voz alta. Grave.
Escreva 80 palavras sobre poluição usando 5 collocations e 1 paráfrase do enunciado.

questions.questionText: We need to make an ______ to recycle more. (esforço)

explanations.general: We need to make an effort to recycle more.

questions.questionText: The price of housing varies ______ between cities. (amplamente)

explanations.general: The price of housing varies widely between cities.

options.text: There was a sharp rise in unemployment in 2009.

explanations.general: Correct answer: There was a sharp rise in unemployment in 2009.

questions.questionText: Young people should take ______ in community projects. (participar)

explanations.general: Young people should take part in community projects.

questions.questionText: In IELTS Writing Task 2, you should copy the question exactly in your introduction.

content.text: 1 sim · 2 não (big/serious mistake) · 3 sim · 4 não (strong coffee) · 5 sim.

1 A large number of young people devote excessive time to social networks. 2 Authorities ought to construct additional hospitals. 3 There was a sharp rise in unemployment in 2009. 4 It is sometimes argued that homework has little value. 5 Air pollution is a major issue in big cities. 6 Technology has transformed the way people communicate. 7 Doing sports is essential for children. 8 The majority of tourists come to the city during the summer.
